porsche-panamera.description: A grand tourer with an unmistakable presence. This Panamera brings the listed 4.0 V8, Sport Chrono and AWD specification together in a car made for the journey as much as the destination.

bmw-m5.description: A distinctive interpretation of the performance saloon. The supplied specification pairs a 4.4 V8 TwinPower Turbo engine with M xDrive, with the understated presence that makes this M5 stand apart.

mercedes-amg.description: A purposeful silhouette and a compelling place in the collection. This AMG GT is listed with a 4.0 V8 Biturbo engine and AMG Speedshift transmission. Explore its character in a personal viewing.

audi-rs6.description: An estate with a performance-led character. The listed 4.0 TFSI, Quattro and Tiptronic specification gives this RS6 Avant its own distinctive place in the Vanguard collection.

tesla-model-3.description: A fresh perspective on the everyday drive. This Model 3 is listed in Long Range specification, with Dual Motor and AWD configuration. Speak with our team about its individual history and condition.

honda-crv.description: Room for a wider horizon. This CR-V EX brings a touring SUV to the collection, with a listed 1.6 i-DTEC engine and AWD configuration. Arrange a conversation to explore the details that matter to you.

chevrolet-camaro.description: An expressive coupe with an analogue spirit. Its supplied specification lists a 6.2 V8, six-speed manual transmission and SS designation. A distinctive choice for someone who enjoys being part of the drive.

ferrari-458.description: An unmistakable silhouette and a special place in the collection. The supplied listing describes a 4.5 V8, F1 dual-clutch transmission and Speciale specification. This demonstration vehicle is currently marked reserved.

faq.title:
Good questions.
Clear conversations.
faq.description: A starting point for your conversation with Vanguard. These are editable examples, not dealership policies.

items.question: How do I arrange a vehicle viewing?
items.answer: Open the vehicle page and choose Request a viewing. Enter a preferred date and time, then send the prepared email from your email application. Wait for the team to confirm before travelling.

items.question: How can I request a test drive?
items.answer: Choose Ask about a test drive on a vehicle page, or select Test drive request on Contact. Send your inquiry and ask the team to confirm the car, arrangements and any requirements. No test drive is booked through this website.

items.question: Is financing assistance available?
items.answer: Use Contact to ask what assistance, if any, the dealership can provide. No finance products, rates or approval promises are offered by this demonstration site.

items.question: How does a vehicle trade-in work?
items.answer: Select Trade-in discussion on Contact and share an overview of your current car. Ask the team whether they accept trade-ins and how they assess a vehicle. No value, acceptance or process is guaranteed by this template.

items.question: How can I check a vehicle’s availability?
items.answer: Check the displayed availability on the vehicle page, then use Enquire about this car to request confirmation. Demonstration stock and availability are illustrative and should be checked directly with the team.

items.question: What is the best way to contact the dealership?
items.answer: Use the email and phone links above or prepare a detailed inquiry using the form. You must send the email yourself. The displayed contact details are demo content and must be replaced before launch.
